consequence.statement: The etcd.operator kvstore-opt configuration value will be ignored and no longer has any effect; environments must rely on the new automatic behavior of respecting the port specified in etcd configuration.
consequence.remediation: Remove the etcd.operator kvstore-opt setting from Helm values as it is now a no-op. Verify that etcd addresses include the correct port if non-standard ports are used, as Cilium will now respect the specified port rather than defaulting to the service port.

original.statement: The etcd.operator kvstore-opt Helm value option is now a no-op and has been removed; Cilium now respects the port in the etcd configuration and automatically enables Kubernetes service DNS name to ClusterIP translation for etcd.

consequence.statement: Setting the etcd.operator kvstore-opt no longer has any effect, but the DNS-to-ClusterIP translation it enabled now happens automatically when needed. Cilium now connects to the port specified in the etcd configuration rather than defaulting to the Kubernetes service port when the address is a service DNS name.
consequence.remediation: Remove the etcd.operator kvstore-opt from the configuration. Check that the etcd endpoint addresses specify the intended port, because Cilium now uses that port instead of the service's port.

corrected.statement: In Cilium 1.16, the etcd.operator kvstore-opt option is a no-op and has been removed, because service DNS to ClusterIP translation for etcd is now automatic. Cilium also now uses the port given in the etcd configuration instead of the service's port. etcd connectivity keeps working, but in a different way.

decision.reason: [ev-793f1f2f3e70] says the `etcd.operator` kvstore-opt option is now a no-op and was removed because Kubernetes service DNS name to ClusterIP translation for etcd is now enabled automatically when needed.
